# Labels

Reference matrix for issues and PRs in this repo.

## Type

| Label      | Use                                           |
| ---------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `feature`  | new content, component, or capability         |
| `fix`      | broken link, wrong content, rendering bug     |
| `design`   | theme, layout, shared component styling       |
| `refactor` | restructuring, no observable change           |
| `docs`     | repo docs (README / CONTRIBUTING / CHANGELOG) |
| `chore`    | deps, scripts, config                         |
| `ci`       | workflows, releases, deployment               |

## Domain

| Label          | Use                               |
| -------------- | --------------------------------- |
| `site:gwm`     | the gwm documentation site        |
| `ds-shared`    | the shared design system package  |
| `infra`        | build, CI, versioning, deployment |
| `dependencies` | dependency bumps                  |

## Status

| Label       | Use                         |
| ----------- | --------------------------- |
| `duplicate` | already tracked elsewhere   |
| `invalid`   | not actionable as filed     |
| `wontfix`   | intentionally not addressed |
